mapper.sql: l.ledger_no, l.account_type, l.direction, l.biz_type, l.amount, l.balance_after, l.ref_type, null as reference_no, l.pay_channel, l.pay_order_no, l.invoice_status, l.ledger_status, original.ledger_no as original_ledger_no, date_format(l.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as create_time, l.remark
mapper.select: select coalesce((select a.available_amount from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.account_type = 1 and a.is_delete = 0 limit 1), 0) as availableBalance, coalesce((select a.available_amount from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.account_type = 1 and a.is_delete = 0 limit 1), 0) as valueAddedBalance, coalesce((select a.available_amount from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.account_type = 3 and a.is_delete = 0 limit 1), 0) as rentalSettlementBalance, coalesce((select a.available_amount from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.account_type = 2 and a.is_delete = 0 limit 1), 0) as performanceDepositAvailable, coalesce((select a.frozen_amount from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.account_type = 2 and a.is_delete = 0 limit 1), 0) as performanceDepositFrozen, coalesce((select sum(a.frozen_amount) from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.is_delete = 0), 0) as performanceDepositFrozen, coalesce(sum(case when l.ledger_status = 1 and l.direction = 1 and l.create_time >= #{monthStart} then l.amount else 0 end), 0) as monthIncome, coalesce(sum(case when l.ledger_status = 1 and l.direction = 2 and l.create_time >= #{monthStart} then l.amount else 0 end), 0) as monthExpense, coalesce((select sum(a.frozen_amount) from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.is_delete = 0), 0) as frozenAmount, coalesce(sum(case when l.invoice_status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as pendingInvoiceCount, coalesce(sum(case when l.ledger_status in (2, 3) then 1 else 0 end), 0) as abnormalLedgerCount, (select count(1) from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_withdrawal w where w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and w.member_id = #{memberId} and w.withdrawal_status = 0 and w.is_delete = 0) as pendingWithdrawalCount from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0

select 'value_added' as accountType, '增值服务余额' as accountName, coalesce(a.available_amount, 0) as availableAmount, coalesce(a.frozen_amount, 0) as frozenAmount, '支付宝充值和增值服务资金独立核算' as description from ry_rental.ry_rental_member m left join ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a on a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and a.member_id = m.member_id and a.account_type = 1 and a.is_delete = 0 where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.is_delete = 0 union all select 'performance_deposit', '履约保证金', coalesce(sum(a.available_amount), 0), coalesce(sum(a.frozen_amount), 0), '联盟履约保证金独立核算，冻结和解冻均保留保证金流水' from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a where a.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and a.member_id = #{memberId} and a.account_type = 2 and a.is_delete = 0 union all select 'rental_settlement', '租金 / 分账资金', coalesce(a.available_amount, 0), coalesce(a.frozen_amount, 0), '订单租金和联盟结算确认后进入该分户，仅该分户允许提现' from ry_rental.ry_rental_member m left join ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_account a on a.tenant_id = m.tenant_id and a.member_id = m.member_id and a.account_type = 3 and a.is_delete = 0 where m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and m.member_id = #{memberId} and m.is_delete = 0
select from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l left join ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger original on original.ledger_id = l.original_ledger_id where order by l.create_time desc, l.ledger_id desc

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l left join ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger original on original.ledger_id = l.original_ledger_id where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.ledger_no = #{ledgerNo} and l.is_delete = 0 limit 1

select from ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger l left join ry_rental.ry_rental_finance_ledger original on original.ledger_id = l.original_ledger_id where l.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and l.member_id = #{memberId} and l.is_delete = 0 order by l.create_time desc, l.ledger_id desc limit 5
